description: A bounded copy of the round-6 GAO decision-page capture (Zyte, the publisher's bytes): its own targets, receipt lines and content-addressed blobs, verbatim, for four decisions. b-403174 et al. is a list GAO's listing cut at 64 characters that its page's caption completes; b-412940 et al. is a 252-character cut list whose page carries no decision text; b-420269 et al. prints its File line as '420269.2', which the reader refuses (unreadable-file-line); b-419305.3 answered Zyte HTTP 520 on every attempt (the first of its three runs' receipts kept) and has no page.
